title: Diffusion-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations - Towards Systematic Quantitative Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the systematic quantitative evaluation of visual counterfactual explanations (VCEs) and their properties (validity, closeness, realism, diversity). While it discusses the broader context of Explainable AI (XAI) and its role in fostering trust and responsible AI, it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The mention of "responsible AI" serves as background motivation for XAI, not the subject of the paper's core evaluation.
